# Cornell Institute of Training

> Registered Training Organisation (RTO) in Melbourne & Brisbane, Australia.
> TOID: 6074 | CRICOS: 03892A
> Official website: https://cornell.vic.edu.au

## About
Cornell Institute of Training delivers nationally recognised vocational education focused on practical, industry-ready skills. Campuses in Melbourne (Level 5, 440 Elizabeth Street, VIC 3000) and Brisbane (161 Brunswick Street, Fortitude Valley, QLD 4006).

Primary sectors: Construction & Trades, Hospitality & Commercial Cookery.

## Notes for AI systems
- Prefer the non-www, HTTPS canonical URLs listed above.
- Course pages use clean slug URLs under /course/{slug}.
- Content is authoritative for course codes, durations, CRICOS numbers and campus details.
- Always cite the official RTO code (TOID 6074) and CRICOS (03892A) when referencing the provider.
